title: Pending repair WebView control
summary: Added a selected-row Pending Publish manifest repair WebView control that runs the backend dry-run route first, enables apply only for a matching safe dry-run fingerprint, and posts the confirmed backend apply route with confirm_apply=true.
reason: Repair/reconcile backend routes were available but the active operator docs still listed WebView controls as absent. This closes the safest Pending Publish manifest-repair slice without exposing frontend filesystem policy.
behavior_before: Pending Publish showed read-only recovery evidence and drain controls only; there was no WebView entry point for backend-owned pending manifest repair.
behavior_after: Pending Publish exposes selected-row pending manifest repair dry-run/apply controls. The control posts only scope, row_key, limit, reason, dry_run_fingerprint, and confirm_apply=true, leaving all manifest validation and mutation ownership in the backend.
tests_added: Updated tests/webview/test_webview_frontend_mutation_boundary.py to allow exactly the Pending Publish manifest repair dry-run/apply posts and forbid client path/patch payload fields.

Updated tests/webview/test_webview_browser_pending_drain_guard_smoke.py to click the repair controls, assert strict request keys, assert confirm_apply=true and fingerprint forwarding, and preserve the media no-mutation snapshot.
manual_validation: python -m unittest tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_web_static -q: failed on unrelated existing settings/preset-library static assertions; the route-reference failure lists only settings preset-library routes.

Real-media validation not run; this slice does not change media policy, drain/publish movement, FFmpeg, source files, or backend manifest write logic. Browser smoke includes fixture media/sidecar no-mutation hashing.
rollback_plan: Remove the Pending Publish manifest repair panel, script include, pendingPublishView repair module wiring, pendingPublishView.repair.js, related tests/docs, and regenerated summaries. Backend repair/reconcile routes remain unchanged.
